name: crouch-torso
title: Crouch the torso
description: Lower the torso lift to its bottom (or a requested height) for floor and low-shelf work.
use_when: The next target is low (floor, low shelf) or the head must look under something.

not_to_be_confused_with.bend: bend pitches the waist forward; crouch lowers the torso vertically.

height_m.description: Optional torso joint target in [-0.54, 0]; omit for the lowest.

postconditions.name: torso_raised
postconditions.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its highest position (travel height).
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: torso_raised
checks.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its highest position (travel height).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: torso_at
checks.meaning: Torso lift joint within 2 cm of the requested position (0 = top, -0.54 = bottom).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: torso_lowered
checks.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its lowest position (floor reach).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

extra_postconditions.name: torso_at
extra_postconditions.meaning: Torso lift joint within 2 cm of the requested position (0 = top, -0.54 = bottom).
extra_postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

extra_postconditions.name: torso_lowered
extra_postconditions.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its lowest position (floor reach).
extra_postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

next.when: the object is on the floor or a low shelf

fallback_for.when: the object is on the floor or a low shelf

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
